title: Ember Orbit: Compact Debug Lens for Multi-request Retry Chains
creator: Maya Chen
description: Deliver a compact, embeddable debug lens called Ember Orbit that surfaces correlated requests, retry chains, and a lightweight payload inspector in a single horizontal strip. Target is the Request Details page in Redwood Console: Ember Orbit is an alternate collapsed view users can expand without leaving the page. The lens focuses on: timeline of retries with per-step metadata, error taxonomy mapping for quick classification, cost-per-retry indicator, model/version tag to link to rollouts, and an inline snapshot diff for payloads. The UI must be fast, privacy-conscious (PII masked by default), and operable by keyboard. Prototype and detailed handoff required for engineering to implement lazy payload fetching and streaming diffs.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype with interactive expand/collapse, hover states, and keyboard nav created and linked
Usability test with at least 6 engineers/SEs documenting time-to-diagnose and clarity metrics
Design tokens and spacing consistent with Console design system; a11y contrast checks pass
Engineering implementation plan reviewed: lazy payload fetch, streaming diffs, and size/cost budget agreed
Privacy compliance: PII masking toggles, audit event emitted when raw payload is revealed
design_notes: Key components: 1) Orbit strip: condensed timeline showing original request + retries as nodes; each node shows status badge, model tag, duration, and cost delta. 2) Taxonomy ribbon: maps error codes to high-level groups with confidence bars. 3) Payload mini-inspector: two-line collapsed diff, expand to sidecar with streaming KV diff and preview. 4) Quick actions: replay button (non-blocking), pin to timeline, open full debug panel. Interaction rules: lazy-fetch payloads on expand, limit first 1000 bytes inline, provide 'Load full payload' audit modal. For rollouts, model tag is clickable and shows the active rollout and a small sparkline of error-rate change post-rollout. Performance constraints: initial strip render must be <120ms for 95% requests; payload fetches rate-limited to avoid spikes. Privacy: default masking, explicit reveal requires role check and emits an audit log with SSO user ID.
decisions: Use a horizontal condensed strip to avoid forcing users into a full-page modal
Implement lazy loading for any raw payload to meet performance goals
Mask PII fields by default and require an explicit reveal action that logs the event
Show 'cost delta' per retry calculated via existing cost model instead of raw token count to better align with billing UX
review_comments: PM (Avery Patel): 'Love the compactness — make sure the model tag ties into rollout history. Can we show if this request was routed to fallback model?'

Eng (Ravi Singh): 'Concern about streaming diffs for very large payloads. Recommend truncation + background fetch for full diff. Also need API contract for /requests/:id/kv-cache and /requests/:id/diff-stream endpoints.'
Security (Nina Alvarez): 'PII masking approach OK. Add an allowance for SREs to request temporary unmask via an OAuth scope with expiry.'
Design Ops (Jamal Reed): 'Spacing and token usage looks good. Please provide tokens for compact badges and chevrons.'
